Compare Two Calibration Results (Grid Predictions)

Source: R/result_class.R
compare_calibrations.Rd

Merges the prediction grids from two calibration_result objects (typically one frequentist and one Bayesian) into a single data frame for paired analysis. Columns are prefixed with the method name.

Usage

compare_calibrations(result_a, result_b, label_a = NULL, label_b = NULL)

Arguments

result_a

A calibration_result.

result_b

A calibration_result.

label_a

Character prefix for result_a columns. Default uses result_a$meta$method.

label_b

Character prefix for result_b columns.

Value

A data frame with log10_concentration plus prefixed columns from each grid.
